key.name: poll-interval-seconds
key.description: How often, in seconds, status and resources are refreshed.

key.name: notifications-enabled
key.description: Send a native notification when the connection state changes on its own (connected/disconnected/error) and stays changed for 10 seconds. Changes you start from the panel are not announced. Note: GNOME's own Do Not Disturb setting already suppresses notification banners system-wide regardless of this setting.

key.name: ping-enabled
key.description: Periodically ping each authorized resource's address to show a reachability dot. Disable to skip pinging entirely.

key.name: ping-interval-seconds
key.description: How often, in seconds, resource reachability is re-checked via ping. Independent of the status poll interval.

key.name: auth-auto-open
key.description: When Twingate enters the authenticating state, automatically open the sign-in URL in your default browser. The URL is opened once per authentication session.

key.name: twingate-path
key.description: Path to the twingate command. Empty finds it in /usr/bin, /usr/local/bin or PATH.

key.name: privileged-helper
key.description: Optional root helper run with pkexec for connect, disconnect, account switch and add, for systems where the twingate CLI can't get root itself (for example, no sudo). It is called as `connect [account]`, `off` or `add`. Empty runs the twingate CLI directly.
